tasks.short: Plan an actual transit safety or accident-prevention programme

steps.what: Read actual fire/accident records, site conditions and existing safety requirements; establish explicit incident categories, periods and site mapping
inputs: Actual incident records and site information
outputs: Read original evidence with explicit category/period/site mapping and missing items

steps.what: Count actual incidents by the selected fixed category, period and site and produce source-linked tables, listing unmapped records separately
inputs: Actual checked records and explicit mapping from s1
outputs: Draft factual incident-count tables and unmapped records

steps.what: Choose the actual safety/prevention objectives, practical measures, responsible interfaces and success checks using site knowledge and the original evidence
outputs: Officer-selected actual programme design and rationale

steps.what: Write the actual prevention programme working plan using bounded wording proposals tied to the selected measures and original evidence
inputs: Actual chosen programme design from s3
Original evidence and exact tables from s1/s2
outputs: Actual draft prevention plan with source-linked factual statements

loop.purpose: Propose wording for the officer's selected safety measures
loop.input: Actual chosen measures, constraints and original evidence
loop.check: Officer checks every factual claim and measure against original evidence and actual site feasibility
loop.stop: Unsupported fact, changed measure or uncertainty remains manual with no implementation
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed counting stays in s2; expressing the selected site-specific plan needs semantic checking

steps.what: Check the complete actual working plan, verify count references and confirm the measures and unresolved assumptions are accurately stated
inputs: Original evidence and selected measures from s1/s3
outputs: Complete checked actual prevention programme working plan

steps.what: Save the checked working plan in the same document workspace
outputs: Stored actual prevention programme working plan

tasks.design: Aggregate actual mapped fire/accident records in {SPREADSHEET}/{OPS_SYSTEM}, then help word the officer's chosen prevention plan in {DOCS}. Retain site-specific programme design, complete checking and the actual written plan; no model predicts offending or chooses operational tactics.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed incident counting and writing up a selected programme can repeat source handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit categories and site/period mapping permit exact aggregation; source-bound wording can be checked against the actual chosen measures.
tasks.still_hard: What prevention measures are practical and appropriate depends on local conditions and responsible human judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The officer understands the actual railway/transit site and its prevention needs.

ambition.what: Produce the actual programme plan more efficiently without asserting an implementation saving.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; confirm actual incident-data access, permitted wording-tool use and programme scope

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed incident aggregation can be deterministic and source-bound plan wording requires human checking; no measured police report-writing benefit is asserted.

assumptions: This is the statement's actual plan-programme branch, producing the complete real working plan; it is not also the alternative implementation episode. Actual implementation, public notices or binding programme adoption must have their real work, authority and separate final-version gated actions if that episode is included.
Original evidence reading, missing-data handling and explicit category/site mapping are counted in s1. No clean new incident feed, inferred risk label or free source coding is assumed.
Baseline100 retained80 gross20 minus4 new upkeep gives16. Estimates are unmeasured task work independent of the prior. Native count reports and templates already used earn no new benefit.
The ordinary same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval. It does not make the programme operative or send it elsewhere.
unknowns: Existing native count reports and permitted source use
research_questions: Observe actual programme planning and distinguish source coding, fixed counting, measure selection and real plan writing.

already_counted.description: Actual evidence reading/mapping, programme judgment, retained writing, whole-plan checking and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain incident mappings and check wording fidelity after source or site changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:15 fixed count points plus5 wording points removed minus4 upkeep=16. Low: incompatible historical incident categories retain12 of15 count points, leaving3 saved; all5 wording points remain saved for the selected plan, giving8 gross minus4 upkeep=4. Measure selection, complete checking, ordinary save and all retained writing remain counted.

tasks.short: Coordinate the actual daily activities of security staff

steps.what: Read actual daily coverage needs, staff availability and current qualification/restriction records and establish explicit staff/shift mapping
outputs: Read original staffing requirements with explicit mapping and unresolved items

steps.what: Compare the actual mapped availability, fixed qualification requirements and times and list coverage conflicts without selecting staff assignments
inputs: Actual checked records and explicit mapping from s1
outputs: Draft fixed-rule conflict/coverage list with original record references

steps.what: Choose actual daily staff activities and resolve operational trade-offs with current local conditions and real personnel knowledge
Write and check the complete actual daily assignment plan, including exact personnel, activity, location and effective time
outputs: Exact complete checked final assignment plan

steps.what: Save the final unpublished assignment plan in the same planning workspace
Perform the actual existing independent duty-command review of the exact final daily assignments and decide whether they may be issued
outputs: Current command release decision for the exact plan or rejection

steps.what: Issue only the exact authorised daily assignment plan through the existing internal staff assignment channel
outputs: Actual authorised daily assignments issued to the intended security staff

steps.what: Actually brief security staff on the issued daily activities, resolve practical questions and coordinate the actual day's work with them
inputs: Actual staff questions and local conditions
outputs: Actual staff briefing and daily coordination

tasks.design: Compare fixed availability/qualification conflicts in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{SPREADSHEET}, retaining actual staff allocation and final plan writing in {PROJECT}. Keep existing command review and actual assignment issue separate from the live briefing; {OTHER} is the actual staff communication medium.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually cross-checking actual availability, coverage and fixed qualification constraints can repeat record comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit staff/shift mapping supports exact conflict checks without ranking people or choosing deployment.
tasks.still_hard: Operational trade-offs, current conditions and effective coordination require human command judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The officer knows the real staff and operating setting and communicates the actual assignments.

ambition.what: Reduce repeatable daily conflict checks without automating deployment decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; confirm staffing-data access and the actual existing command route with responsible owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed availability and qualification comparisons can be deterministic; actual deployment selection and staff coordination remain human work.

assumptions: This represents an actual daily-activity coordination episode with a real final assignment plan and existing distinct duty-command release, not also an assumed training session. Duty command authority denotes that real role, not an invented supervisor or new approval baseline; map the actual route if different.

s1 counts original staffing-data reading, completeness checking and explicit mapping. Actual upstream staff availability/credential entry is existing work, unchanged; no newly captured structured feed is supplied for free.

The exact final assignment exists in s4/s5 before s6; any plan or relevant current-condition change voids a1. The author checks her own plan but does not approve it. The negligible minimum share1 same-system save s5 is fully retained and ungated; s7 is separate actual operative issue, also fully retained.
s8 is live briefing/coordination, not a hidden new written order. If that discussion changes the actual assignments, return through final plan and existing command review before re-issue.

unknowns: Actual qualification/availability mapping and native conflict checks
research_questions: Observe fixed comparisons separately from staffing decisions, final plan writing, command review, actual issue and live briefing.

Actual existing distinct duty-command final review

incremental.description: Maintain fixed staffing/qualification/time mappings and check conflicts after source changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete checked s4/s5 personnel/activity/location/time assignment plan under current actual duty conditions; any change voids command release

tasks.short: Interview actual applicant references and record factual work-history information

steps.what: Locate and read the actual applicant/reference case, the requested work-history questions and permitted contact details through the native case view
inputs: Actual applicant/reference case and contact details
outputs: Read original case, identified reference and actual questions

steps.what: Actually interview the neighbour, associate or former employer, clarify actual work-history facts and distinguish direct knowledge, uncertainty and opinion
inputs: Actual identified reference and questions from s1
outputs: Actual reference statements, source identity and clarified uncertainties

steps.what: Write and check the actual factual reference-interview record, preserving attribution and separating reported history from opinion or unresolved contradiction
inputs: Actual statements and uncertainties from s2

steps.what: Save the factual interview record in the same existing case system
inputs: Complete checked actual interview record from s3

tasks.design: Configure actual reference-case lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining the real {TELEPHONY} interview and separately written factual record. No model evaluates candidate suitability, scores credibility or generates witness statements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current case, identified reference and requested history questions can require navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native case view may shorten retrieval while retaining original source details.
tasks.still_hard: Clarifying a reference's actual knowledge, uncertainty and contradictions requires a real interview and careful attribution.
tasks.human_edge: The officer hears the reference directly and records what was actually said.

ambition.what: Ease case retrieval without automating reference interviews or hiring judgment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; confirm existing applicant/reference access and contact scope with the actual case owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case views can aid retrieval, while factual reference interviews and attributed records remain human work; no measured report-writing saving is asserted.

assumptions: s1 counts actual applicant-specific reading and contact-scope checking, not a repeated termly setup. s2 produces the actual statements; s3 separately counts the actual required record after the interview. No transcript or structured response feed is assumed.

The actual external human telephone conversation is not an automated written send. No written invitation, signed declaration, formal reference certification or hiring decision is hidden in it; any actual such action needs its own final version, existing authority and separate gated step.

Native record templates are considered without claiming a new report-writing saving. The ordinary same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval.
Baseline100 retained99 gross1 minus0.3 new case-view upkeep=0.7, using unmeasured task-work estimates independent of the prior. A native view already used earns no new benefit.
research_questions: Observe case lookup, actual reference interview and actual record writing separately before estimating any further tool benefit.

already_counted.description: Original case reading, actual reference interview, factual record writing and ordinary save

incremental.description: Keep actual reference/case links current without creating a second applicant file

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10 lookup points at90% retained saves1 minus0.3 upkeep=0.7. Low: historical applicant/reference identifiers do not link to the current case view, retaining all10 lookup points; use existing manual original-case retrieval without new helper upkeep. Actual interview, factual record writing and ordinary save remain fully retained.
